name: query_revit_geometry
author: hprebar
title: Query Revit Element Geometry Summaries
description: Queries Revit elements and returns geometric summaries (solid count, volume in cubic meters, surface area in square meters, and bounding boxes) without modifying the document.
notes: Calculates solid volume, surface area, and bounding dimensions in meters from Revit element geometry.

elementIds.description: List of Revit Element IDs to inspect.

detailLevel.description: Geometry detail level: Coarse, Medium, Fine.

includeFaces.description: Whether to extract face surface area summaries.
